warnings: Structural roof-framing plan 'แปลนโครงสร้างหลังคา' (S-05) → roof_frame_plan (op04: structural roof framing is extracted, not skipped as roof_plan).

Trusses T2 on the gable grids 1 and 9, T1 on grids 2-8, each drawn from the eave line A' (-1.60) to the eave line C'' (10.60). A truss is one prefabricated member, so each is recorded as a single element eave-to-eave (bearing on the RB1 beams at rows A, B and C of S-04), not split per bay like an RC beam.

The '3.00' chains near grids 1 and 6 mark the truss reinforcement-lap zone ('ระยะทาบเสริมความแข็งแรง T2 / T1 (ดูขยาย)', 'ด้านทาบเสริมความแข็งแรง เปลี่ยนแปลงได้ตามเหมาะสม') from C'' up to B'' (7.60) — recorded as grid dummy B'' per §4 rule 4.
Purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (§0.2). Section 'C -100x50x20x3.2 mm' read as lipped channel d100 x b50 x lip20 x t3.2 (§6a lipped-channel key order).
